user.title: Pair Jibo locally
user.description: Open Home Assistant pairing on Jibo, then enter its hostname.local or LAN IP address. Home Assistant and Jibo must be able to reach each other on your local network. You will compare a code on both devices before approving the connection. No Phoenix connection code or Home Assistant access token is needed.

data.host: Jibo hostname or LAN IP address
data.legacy_device_id: Existing Jibo device to copy its room

reauth_confirm.title: Pair Jibo again
reauth_confirm.description: Open a fresh Home Assistant pairing window on the same Jibo. Compare the new code before approving on Jibo and here. Existing credentials and certificate pins will only be replaced after that physical pairing succeeds.

data.host: Jibo hostname or LAN IP address
data.legacy_device_id: Existing Jibo device to copy its room

reconfigure.title: Change Jibo address
reconfigure.description: For an already paired Jibo, this changes only its address and verifies the stored certificate and local credential. It cannot trust a different robot or certificate. A legacy cloud connection instead requires physical local pairing; explicitly select the old Jibo device whose room should be copied, or choose not to copy a room.

data.host: Jibo hostname or LAN IP address
data.legacy_device_id: Existing Jibo device to copy its room

pair_confirm.title: Compare the pairing code
pair_confirm.description: Home Assistant code: **{code}**. Check that Jibo shows exactly the same eight digits. If they differ, reject the request on Jibo and stop this flow. If they match, approve on Jibo, then confirm below. Pairing expires after two minutes.

data.confirm_pairing: The codes match and I approved this connection on Jibo

error.invalid_host: Enter a hostname or IP address and a valid local port, without a URL path, username, query or fragment.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach Jibo locally. Check its address, local network, direct Home Assistant mode and pairing window. No cloud fallback is used.
error.unsupported_tls: Jibo did not offer the required encrypted local connection. Check the direct integration firmware.
error.unsupported_protocol: Jibo uses an unsupported local protocol. Update the robot and this integration.
error.certificate_changed: The local certificate differs from the pinned pairing. No credential was sent to that peer. Verify the robot and start physical pairing again.
error.pairing_verification_failed: The pairing exchange could not be verified. Reject it on Jibo and start a fresh pairing window.
error.pairing_pending: Approve the matching code on Jibo first, then confirm again here.
error.pairing_expired: The pairing window expired. Close this flow, open a fresh window on Jibo and start again.
error.pairing_rejected: Jibo rejected this pairing. Open a fresh window only if you want to try again.
error.pairing_unavailable: Open a fresh physical Home Assistant pairing window on Jibo. Another pairing may already be in progress.
error.invalid_claim: This pairing claim was rejected. Stop this flow and start a fresh physical pairing window.
error.pairing_failed: Jibo could not complete the pairing. Check its local screen before starting a new window.
error.rate_limited: Too many pairing attempts. Wait and open a fresh physical pairing window.
error.codes_not_confirmed: Compare both codes and approve on Jibo before confirming here.
error.invalid_legacy_device: Choose one of this legacy installation’s Jibo devices, or explicitly choose not to copy a room.
error.invalid_auth: The stored local credential was rejected. Pair the same Jibo again through reauthentication.
error.wrong_robot: This address belongs to a different robot or pairing generation. The stored connection was not replaced.

abort.already_configured: This locally identified Jibo is already configured.
abort.wrong_robot: This is a different Jibo. Add it as a separate integration entry instead.
abort.pairing_expired: Start a fresh physical pairing window on Jibo and a new setup flow.
abort.reauth_successful: Jibo has been paired again locally.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Jibo’s local address was verified and updated.

init.title: Jibo voice settings
init.description: Choose the conversation agent for Jibo home commands. The default is Home Assistant’s built-in agent; another agent is used only when explicitly selected. Assign the Jibo device to an area for room context. Allow announcements is a local opt-in; they use Jibo’s current master volume. Quiet hours use Home Assistant’s time zone and may cross midnight. Add an exact routine phrase and an Assist-exposed scene or script; reopen these settings to add another phrase. Routines are reported as started, without claiming their resulting device states.

error.invalid_shortcut: Choose a unique phrase of up to 80 characters and a scene or script. Ordinary Jibo commands are reserved. You can save up to 16 phrases; their combined size must fit one connector message.
error.shortcut_not_exposed: Expose this scene or script to Assist before adding a routine phrase.
error.invalid_quiet_hours: Choose valid start and end times for quiet hours.

invalid_message.message: Use a nonempty plain-text announcement of up to 300 characters.

unsupported_robot_announcements.message: Direct Jibo announcements need BE 13.2.0 or later and the direct Home Assistant service mode.
